ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points $A, B, C$ are on the circle $\odot O$, $\angle B=55^\circ$, and $\angle BOC=70^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle C$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle BOC=70^\circ$ and it subtends the same arc $\overset{\frown}{BC}$,\\
it follows that $\angle A=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOC=35^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle B+\angle A+\angle BDA=180^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle ADB=90^\circ$,\\
and hence $\angle ODC=90^\circ$,\\
therefore $\angle C=180^\circ-\angle ODC-\angle BOC=20^\circ$.\\
Thus, the answer is: $\boxed{20}$.
